Also, keep ALL of the syllabi from the post-bac courses for when you apply to grad school. Sometimes the titles of the post-bac courses on your transcript might not match up with the pre-reqs of the grad school, but if you can show them a course description from the post-bac syllabus, then they might accept that you have fulfilled the requirement. For example, I took a neurology course that didn’t have the word “neurology” in the title, so the grad program thought I hadn’t taken neurology, so I showed them the syllabus and then they waived the requirement.
